name: Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement Scheme
benefit: - The assistance under this scheme will be limited to 80% or ₹ 1,00,000/- (excluding GST and all other applicable taxes), whichever is less, on PBG charges paid in a financial year.
_eligibility_text: - Applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe category. - He/she should represent/own any MSEs unit. - MSEs availing loans from any Scheduled Commercial Banks, Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs), and State Finance Corporations will be considered under the scheme.
